newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 25.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Lower House passes bill on brain death.
-- Finance Ministry likely to order Nissan Mutual Life to suspend operations.
-- Government to register negative growth in 1998/99 defense spending.
-- Sakura Bank Ltd to promote Akishige Okada to president.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto phoned Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori five times during standoff about possible storming of the ambassador's residence.
-- Two rebels of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) were "executed" by Peruvian commandos storming the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima.
